Centre of mass and centre of gravity
Motion of a satellite: orbital velocity and time period of the satellite
Potential and kinetic energy of the satellite
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank compiled 2026-10-06 from pyqs/01-neb-2024.json, 02-neb-2023.json, 03-neb-2022.json, 04-neb-2021.json (x2) in this unit (stems, marks, solutions verbatim in essence).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on gravitation

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Five questions: G statement (2024), escape-velocity derivation plus value (2023), alien-planet g scaling (2022: 8M at 2R doubles g to 19.6), satellite potential energy (2021: 200 kg at 400 km gives minus 1.18x10^9 J). Gravity scales as M/R2 — every numerical is that ratio in disguise.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: F = GMm/r2, G = 6.67x10^-11 · g = GM/R2 · v_escape = sqrt(2GM/R) = sqrt(2gR) = 11.2 km/s · v_orbit = sqrt(GM/r) · U = -GMm/r · E_total = -GMm/2r · g(h) = g(1-2h/R), g(d) = g(1-d/R)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Point-mass (or spherical) gravity with centre-to-centre r (meaning satellite r = R + h, never h alone). Escape derivation ignores drag and other bodies. The M/R2 scaling compares surfaces only. Bound orbits carry negative total energy (why the minus sign matters).

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Planet 8M/2R: g scales 8/4 = 2x, so 19.6 m/s2 (NEB 2022). Satellite 200 kg at 400 km: r = 6.8x10^6 m, U = -GMm/r = -1.18x10^9 J (NEB 2021). Escape needs 11.2 km/s regardless of projectile mass.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): half m v2 = GMm/R gives v = sqrt(2GM/R) = sqrt(2gR) = 11.2 km/s. NEB 2022 (3): g_p = G(8M)/(2R)2 = 2g = 19.6 m/s2. NEB 2021 (3): U = -(6.67x10^-11 x 6x10^24 x 200)/6.8x10^6 = -1.18x10^9 J. NEB 2024 (2): law statement plus G value.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: altitude used as orbital radius; G value forgotten (6.67x10^-11); positive PE for bound satellites; g-variation formulas applied beyond small h/d. Newton fails extreme fields (Mercury needs Einstein).

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Escape: kinetic equals binding energy GMm/R. Orbital: gravity supplies centripetal force (v = sqrt(GM/r), T = 2 pi sqrt(r3/GM) — Kepler III). g-variation from g = GM/r2 evaluated at R+h and R-d. Centre of mass vs gravity distinction for extended bodies.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Scaling questions: write the M/R2 ratio, plug multiples. Satellite questions: write r = R + h first line. Escape: sqrt(2gR) shortcut with gR known. Bound means negative total energy.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (2): gravitation law + G. NEB 2023 (5): escape velocity derive + value. NEB 2022 (3): 8M/2R planet g. NEB 2021 (3): 200 kg satellite at 400 km PE. NEB 2021 (3): planet mass/radius variant.
